metadata.method: Scores sorted descending with stable centroid tie-breaks; select ceil(10%) and ceil(25%). 8-neighbor connected components on regular centroid grid; discard components <2 cells; polygonize cell rectangles. Rank within threshold using 0.60 mean-score percentile, 0.15 log-area percentile, 0.10 mine-proximity score, 0.15 occurrence-proximity score.
